guaranteedRewards.name: Strider Stew
tooltip: Use: Restores 17 health over 18 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 1 Intellect for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%.
classicTooltip: Use: Restores 58 health over 21 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 seconds eating you will become well fed and gain 4 Stamina and Spirit for 15 min.

narrative.details:
Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, adventurer--fresh strider stew. Delicious!

Perhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?

Before I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.

Now, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
narrative.objectives: Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
